Name: Zachariah, King of Israel
Summary: Zachariah, son of Jeroboam II, reigned six months and did evil, and was slain publicly by Shallum, ending Jehu's dynasty in its fourth generation as the LORD had spoken.
KeyStory: Zachariah slain by Shallum after six months.
RelatedPeople: Jeroboam II, King of Israel; Shallum, King of Israel
LifeLesson: God's word outlasts dynasties: Jehu's house ended exactly when He said it would.
